customer_ops_evo: Hi team — wire to beneficiary returned with reason 'INVALID_BIC'. Customer says funds debited then returned. Transfer ID: T-987654321. Can someone check?
alex_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the payload (mask acct numbers) and the exact message from the bank?
customer_ops_evo: Bank message: "Return: INVALID BIC - beneficiary bank does not recognise BIC". Payload below (masked):
```json
{
  "transfer_id": "T-987654321",
  "amount": "12500.00",
  "currency": "USD",
  "beneficiary_name": "Endeavor Health LLC",
  "beneficiary_iban": "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00",
  "beneficiary_bic": "DEUTDEFF-GB",  // CSV import added suffix
  "instructions": "Payroll Q1"
}
```
alex_support: Ah — I see `DEUTDEFF-GB` in the payload. That `-GB` suffix looks suspicious. Our validator previously allowed non-alphanumeric chars in BIC.
maria_ops: Payments-bot log shows: `payments:transfer:T-987654321 -> status: RETURNED; reason_code: INVALID_BIC; raw_bank_msg: 'BIC not found'`
payments-bot: Automated note: Refund initiated for network fee waiver (customer support ticket 5632).
jon_eng: Thanks for the sample. Repro locally: our normalization step never strips trailing country tags if users paste them from ERP exports (some ERPs append `-GB` or `_US`). I can reproduce: `DEUTDEFF-GB` fails lookup, while `DEUTDEFF` passes.
alex_support: Any quick mitigation? Customer is blocked for payroll run tomorrow.
jon_eng: Short-term: we can patch the validation layer in the public API to reject or auto-normalize common suffixes (strip `-` or `_` followed by 2 letters). I'll push a hotfix to staging in ~30m, then to prod after smoke tests. Also recommend we run a backfill to normalize stored beneficiary BIC fields for pending transfers.
maria_ops: Can we do an emergency manual correction for this single transfer now? If legal/ops approve, we can reissue with corrected BIC.
alex_support: Customer requests reissue now. Please list exact action steps and ETA.
jon_eng: Action plan: 1) ops: confirm correct BIC with customer and re-submit transfer using `DEUTDEFF` (ETA 15m). 2) eng: deploy validation hotfix to prod (ETA 60m). 3) eng: submit DB migration script to normalize stored BICs for all pending outgoing wires with pattern `*-??` or `_??` (ETA 3h for rollout and monitoring). 4) support: apply one-time fee waiver (done by payments-bot) and communicate SLO credit.
maria_ops: I'll confirm correct BIC with the customer on the call now. Alex, please prepare the re-submit checklist.
alex_support: On it. Re-submit checklist: verify beneficiary accepts USD, confirm intermediary bank (if any), mask PANs, attach bank message, set `beneficiary_bic` -> `DEUTDEFF`.
customer_ops_evo: Confirmed correct BIC is `DEUTDEFF`. Please resend. We're good to proceed.
payments-bot: Re-submit queued as job 0xabc123; status: pending -> submitted.
jon_eng: I'll open a PR with the normalization regex and unit tests. Also adding logging to count how many BICs contain separators/suffixes so we can report scope.
alex_support: Thanks everyone. Alex to customer: I'll follow up once wire clears or if any further errors. :thumbsup:
maria_ops: Postmortem action: add a quick validation rule on the UI/CSV import to warn users about trailing country suffixes in BIC/Swift fields.
jon_eng: Filed ENG-PLAT-998 for the hotfix + migration. Will post updates here as I deploy.
alex_support: Closing loop: customer refunded network fee, re-submission initiated, hotfix + migration queued. Will update ticket 5632 after final settlement.
jon_eng: Deploy started to canary.
payments-bot: Notifying billing: network fee refunded to account `END-900` (ref 5632).
